source: The neighborhood repair clinic opens on May 14 at the Eastside Library. Volunteers will offer bicycle tune-ups from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.; the library's book sale remains scheduled for May 14 in the adjoining hall.

source: The pantry will pack 240 weekend meal bags for the spring distribution. Each bag contains two breakfasts and one shelf-stable dinner; 60 separate hygiene kits are already assembled for pickup.
objective: Revise the planned meal-bag total to 300 and make the update suitable for the volunteer bulletin.

source: The courtyard mural is awaiting final approval from the facilities team. The artist's color study was approved last week, and the scaffolding reservation is confirmed for June 3.
objective: Update the mural's facilities approval status to approved and tighten this progress note.

source: The public compost pilot starts July 8, with four collection bins at the north entrance. Rowan Ellis leads the pilot; the garden team will continue its separate Saturday soil workshops through August.
objective: For the launch brief, change the compost pilot start date to July 15, increase its collection bins to six, and name Nadia Brooks as pilot lead.

source: The museum's oral-history recording day is listed for September 12 in Studio B. The volunteer orientation is on September 5 in the main gallery, and registration closes September 9.
objective: The recording-day date may have shifted. Refresh this notice so it feels current and clear.

source: The neighborhood council will review the courtyard fountain proposal on Tuesday, and no decision has been recorded. The library's seed exchange opens at nine. A contractor will repaint the south stairwell next month. The bicycle racks beside the hall hold twelve bikes.
objective: Update the fountain proposal's decision status: the council approved it at Tuesday's meeting.

source: The coastal observatory plans to open its public telescope nights in November. Its weather station sends readings every hour. The visitor center sells printed sky maps. A new footbridge crosses the marsh trail.
objective: Update the public telescope nights: the observatory has cancelled the November program and will not host any sessions that month.

source: The ceramics workshop is scheduled for Saturday, and registration remains open through Thursday. The workshop will provide clay but not aprons. The garden club waters the planters on Mondays. The town clock was restored last spring. The café closes at six.

source: The ferry office posts tide notices each morning. The pier clock runs five minutes fast. The ticket window closes at seven. A volunteer group collects litter on the west beach.
